name: Council of Clermont
summary: Pope Urban II preaches at the Council of Clermont, calling on Western Christians to liberate Jerusalem from Muslim rule and aid the Byzantine Emperor Alexios I against the Seljuks. The crowd responds 'Deus vult!' (God wills it). Urban's call launches the First Crusade and establishes the papacy's claim to direct wars of religious conquest.

_quarry.structural_significance: Launches the Crusading movement that reshapes medieval European politics, creates the Latin states in the East, and entrenches papal claims to direct Christian military action
